verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a one-time-passcode generator (TOTP/HOTP) with code sync, transfer and organization features. User-defined event-driven automation rules are outside this product category, and nothing in the evidence shows the app ships any rule or trigger engine. Its automatic code syncing on sign-in is a fixed built-in behavior, not user-defined rules, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
